_ownership: Three lanes write this file: yd-store (chrome: announcement, logo, nav, hero, social, promos, utility), yd-pdp (backorder), yd-cat (nav notes). It was created independently on three branches at the same path with NO overlapping keys, so git presents an add/add conflict and 'take mine' silently deletes another lane's keys. THE RESOLUTION IS THE UNION. Namespace new keys by owner; never rewrite another lane's key.

sale_callouts._note: The coloured line the live product page shows above the price on warehouse-sale products — '$20 Bottoms', '$10 Tops'. Measured across 45 live product pages: the mapping is exact and unanimous, $10.00 -> '$10 Tops' (10 of 10) and $20.00 -> '$20 Bottoms' (20 of 20), with no callout at any of the eight other sale prices. So it is keyed on the sale price alone and needs no category — which also avoids config/promotions.yd.json's warning that sale membership must never be derived from the warehouse-sale category. WHEN THE SALE CHANGES, EDIT THIS: an unmatched price simply shows nothing, so a stale entry is a wrong claim, not a blank.
